title: Transport of restricted section pullback through the shift comparison
statement: Let $S,Y,Y\prime$ be schemes, $a:Y\prime\to Y$, $h:Y\to S$, $h\prime:Y\prime\to S$, and $w:a\gg h=h\prime$. Let $U\to S$ be etale, $p\in\mathbb N$, and $F,F\prime$ abelian etale sheaves. Put $K=F[0]$, $K\prime=F\prime[0]$, $L=D^+(a^*)$, and let $f:L(K)\to K\prime$ be any derived morphism. Let $T,T\prime$ be restriction followed by derived sections [def-sbc-raw-restricted-cohomology-comparison-map], $e_F,e_{F\prime}$ their single-complex comparisons, and $s_F,s_{F\prime}$ their shifted zeroth-homology comparisons. Let $\tau:T\to LT\prime$ be the explicitly constructed derived section pullback before homology [lem-sbc-restricted-derived-section-zero-comparison]. Then $H^0(\tau_{K[p]})\gg H^0(T\prime(c_{L,p,K}\gg f[p]))\gg s_{F\prime}.\mathrm{hom}=s_F.\mathrm{hom}\gg H^p(e_F.\mathrm{inv}\gg\tau_K\gg T\prime(f)\gg e_{F\prime}.\mathrm{hom})$, where $c$ is the canonical shift comparison. The conclusion computes no restricted coefficient or cohomology pullback map and makes no assumption that $f$ is the image of a sheaf morphism.

proof.text: Prove shift compatibility of the canonical right-derived unit by restricting it to K-injectives. Express that restriction using the K-injective equivalence unit, its counit, and rightDerivedFunctorIsoKInjectives.inv; naturality and the equivalence triangle identity identify the expression. These factors commute with shifts. Extend to every homotopy object using a quasi-isomorphism to a K-injective representative. This is canonical_unit_commShift, proved privately without new holes.

The derived restriction isomorphism commutes with shifts by the existing exact-functor composition and natural-isomorphism compatibility instances. The derived section pullback commutes with shifts because its adjunction unit does, and because the Leray comparison commutes with shifts when its three right-derived units do. Use Adjunction.commShift_rightDerivedFunctorUnit for the direct-image unit and the preceding private proof for both global-section units. Whisker and compose these compatibilities, inserting associators and the bounded-below lift comparison, to prove shift compatibility of tau.

For arbitrary shift-compatible functors T, Tprime and L and a shift-compatible transformation tau, apply NatTrans.shift_app_comm at K and naturality of the target functor shift comparison at f. Apply zeroth homology and naturality of the homology shift isomorphism. Insert H^p(e.hom) followed by H^p(e.inv), whose composite is the identity, to obtain the conjugation formula. This is the private transport_homology lemma.

Specialize this generic calculation to Evaluation.functor and its explicit shiftIso and singleIso in abstract abelian categories (evaluation_shift_transport). Instantiate with the two exact etale restrictions and global-section functors and the preceding shift-compatible tau. All definitions reduce to those of the unchanged target formula. Doing the evaluation calculation abstractly avoids repeated unfolding of concrete sheaf-category constructions.

lean.statement:
theorem restrictedDerivedSections_shiftTransport {S Y Y' : Scheme.{v}}
    (a : Y' ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ S) (h' : Y' ⟶ S) (w : a ≫ h = h') (p : ℕ)
    (F : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (F' : Sheaf Y'.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (f : D+(upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} a).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F) ⟶
        (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F') (U : S.Etale) :
    let T' := sectionsFunctor ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ h').obj U)
    let K := (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F
    let τ := Functor.whiskerLeft
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.ι ⋙
        D(upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (Limits.pullback.snd U.hom h)))
      (derivedSectionPullback (rawAffineRestrictedMap a h h' w U)) ≫
      Functor.whiskerRight
        (Functor.whiskerLeft DerivedCategory.Plus.ι
          (derivedRestrictionIso a h h' w U).hom)
        (rightDerivedGlobalSections AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (Limits.pullback U.hom h'))
    let e := Evaluation.singleIso
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (Limits.pullback.snd U.hom h))
      (Sheaf.Γ (Limits.pullback U.hom h).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) F
    let e' := Evaluation.singleIso
      (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (Limits.pullback.snd U.hom h'))
      (Sheaf.Γ (Limits.pullback U.hom h').smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}) F'
    (restrictedSectionPullback a h h' w U).app (K⟦(p : ℤ)⟧) ≫
      (T' ⋙ DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} 0).map
        ((D+(upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} a).commShiftIso (p : ℤ)).hom.app K ≫
          (shiftFunctor _ (p : ℤ)).map f) ≫ (shiftIso h' p F' U).hom =
      (shiftIso h p F U).hom ≫
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (p : ℤ)).map
          (e.inv ≫ τ.app K ≫ T'.map f ≫ e'.hom)
